quality_attributes.name: Security
quality_attributes.description: Protection of user accounts, credentials, biometric data, payment information and sessions against unauthorized access or disclosure.
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit. The project description requires ensuring 'the security and privacy of user data, including payment information' and compliance with ISO 27001; S1 mandates end-to-end encryption between device and database; S3 requires flushing biometric data after login; S4 mandates session termination after 15 minutes of inactivity; S12/S13 imply a separate administrator role whose access must be controlled.
evidence: Project description: 'ensure the security and privacy of user data, including payment information'
Project description: 'comply with the relevant security and data protection standards, such as ISO 27001'
S1: 'secured with an end-to-end encryption of information between user device and app database'
S3: 'flush out user thumb impression as soon as the user has been able to login'
S4: 'after an inactivity of 15 minutes'

quality_attributes.name: Privacy and Regulatory Compliance
quality_attributes.description: Handling of personal, biometric, location and usage data in accordance with GDPR, the Privacy Directive and local (EU or China) regulations applicable to the deployment location.
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit. The project description lists GDPR, the Privacy Directive and local EU or China standards as constraints. The system processes personal data (S1), biometric data (S3), payment data (S8), location data (S5, S6) and retains usage history (S11). Which regulation applies depends on 'the location of the university', which is not stated.
evidence: Project description: 'comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Privacy Directive'
Project description: 'comply with local regulations and standards, including EU or China standards, depending on the location of the university'
S11: 'view and download their bike usage history up to last 3 months'

quality_attributes.name: Interoperability
quality_attributes.description: Ability to exchange information with external parties: a variety of third-party payment platforms, bank/card payment, and SMS/email delivery of verification codes.
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit for payment: the project description requires compatibility with 'a variety of third-party payment platforms'; S8 requires bank account and debit/credit card payment. Strongly implied for messaging: S2 requires sending codes via SMS or email, which involves external delivery channels.
evidence: Project description: 'compatible with a variety of third-party payment platforms to allow users to pay for the bike rental fee seamlessly'
S8: 'pay via their bank account or by their debit/credit card'
S2: 'sent a verification code via an SMS or email'

quality_attributes.name: Portability (multi-platform access)
quality_attributes.description: The functionality must be usable from both web and mobile devices.
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit. The project description requires the application to be 'available on web and mobile devices' and 'accessible through both web and mobile devices to maximize the availability of the service'. S3 biometric login and S5/S6 location and scanning features rely on device capabilities that differ between web and mobile clients.
evidence: Project description: 'available on web and mobile devices'
Project description: 'accessible through both web and mobile devices to maximize the availability of the service'
S3: 'by using their biometric thumb-impression'

quality_attributes.name: Usability
quality_attributes.description: The application must be easy to use for all potential riders, including finding, navigating to and registering bikes.
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit in the project description ('user-friendly and easy to use for all potential riders'). Supported by S5 (user-defined proximity), S6 (navigation help, two code-entry options) and S3 (biometric login alternative). No measurable usability target is given.
evidence: Project description: 'user-friendly and easy to use for all potential riders'
S6: 'App must help the biker to navigate to the available bike'
S5: 'close proximity defined by him/her'

quality_attributes.name: Performance (timeliness)
quality_attributes.description: Time-bound behaviour: prompt update of bike availability, tracking of bike locations, enforcement of code and session timeouts, and notification before rental expiry.
quality_attributes.rationale: Strongly implied, not explicitly quantified. S7 requires removal 'as soon as' a bike is registered; the project description requires tracking and displaying bike locations; S2, S4 and S9 impose time windows. No latency or throughput targets are stated.
evidence: S7: 'As soon as the bike is registered it must be removed from the list of available bikes'
Project description: 'capable of tracking and displaying the location of available bikes within a 1000-meter radius'
S9: 'notify the biker X minutes prior to the expiry of their rental time'

quality_attributes.name: Reliability (correctness of rental and bike state)
quality_attributes.description: Bike availability, rental durations and charges must be recorded and applied correctly and consistently across biker and administrator views.
quality_attributes.rationale: Strongly implied. S7 requires a registered bike to leave the available list, so the same bike must not be rentable twice; S9 applies overtime charges, which requires correct rental timing; S12 shows the same status data to administrators; S11/S13 rely on accurate usage records.
evidence: S7: 'it must be removed from the list of available bikes'
S9: 'Any overtime rides are subject to additional charges'
S12: 'view all of the bikes in the city as available or under utilization'

quality_attributes.name: Modifiability
quality_attributes.description: Ability to accommodate changes in payment methods/platforms and in applicable regional regulations without disproportionate effort.
quality_attributes.rationale: Strongly implied. S8 says cash is 'Currently' not supported, suggesting payment options may change; the project description requires compatibility with 'a variety' of payment platforms and compliance with EU or China standards 'depending on the location'.
evidence: S8: 'Currently cash payments are not supported'
Project description: 'a variety of third-party payment platforms'
Project description: 'including EU or China standards, depending on the location of the university'

quality_attributes.name: Sustainability
quality_attributes.description: The software should be designed to minimize the carbon footprint and promote sustainable mobility.
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit in the project description, but not linked to any functional requirement and not quantified. It is unclear whether it refers to the software's own resource/energy efficiency or to the service's goal of promoting cycling.
evidence: Project description: 'designed to minimize the carbon footprint and promote sustainable mobility'
